# voices

`folio-voice/v1` profiles read out of this instance's `library/`: the shared base `agent-skill-authoring` plus one override per agent vendor, on the owner's ruling of 2026-09-20: 'for model specific sources, make those model specific voices.' Arrived from agent-skills on 2026-10-01 when that instance dissolved into cat-harness's concern groups (bean `j7ql`); the corpus they cite came with them, so citations stay INTERNAL (no `instance:` key). The rules are deliberately NOT formally constrained: owner, 2026-09-20, 'preference leave unstructured schema, agentic review b/c of best practice drift, not formal' — published best practice is revised without notice, so a schema gate would pin whichever vintage was current when it was written. VENDOR OVERRIDES live in the reserved `vendors/` sub-sub-graph inside this directory — `voices/vendors/<id>/voice.json` — declared from within by `voices/voices.json` and `voices/vendors/vendors.json` (owner, 2026-09-22 and bean `rkqp`). A vendor voice still declares what it overrides in its own `extends` field, so nothing infers the relation from a path.

Part of [C@T Harness](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `voices`, holding `voices`.

| file | what it is | used by |
